title: Grimms' Fairy Tales
author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm
firstLine: A certain king had a beautiful garden, and in the garden stood a tree which bore golden apples.
begins: The first story is The Golden Bird: a king's golden apples are stolen each night, and the gardener's youngest son, keeping watch, shoots at the golden bird, which drops a golden feather.
happens: Sixty-two tales (translated by Edgar Taylor and Marian Edwardes). In Hansel and Gretel, two children taken into a forest are caught by a witch, and Gretel pushes her into her oven. In Little Red-Cap a wolf devours a girl and her grandmother, and a huntsman cuts them out. Ashputtel is helped by a hazel tree and birds to marry the prince. Snowdrop eats the queen's poisoned apple, and wakes when the piece falls from her lips as a prince carries her coffin. Rumpelstiltskin spins straw into gold for a miller's daughter until she guesses his name. The Fisherman and his Wife ends with the wife's greed sending them back to their pigsty. Briar Rose sleeps a hundred years with the whole castle.
